Frequently Asked Questions
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
What is EngageBay?
 
 
 
 
EngageBay is an all-in-one CRM platform built for small businesses and startups. It combines marketing automation, email marketing, sales CRM, appointment scheduling, live chat, and helpdesk into a single tool — so you don't need to stitch together multiple subscriptions. Founded in 2017, EngageBay is used by 46,000+ businesses worldwide and offers a free plan for up to 15 users with no credit card required.
 
 
 
 
 
Is EngageBay really free?
 
 
 
Yes. EngageBay offers a genuinely free plan — not a trial — that includes CRM, email marketing, live chat, and helpdesk features for up to 15 users. No credit card is required to sign up. Paid plans start at $12.74/user/month if you need advanced features like marketing automation workflows, custom reporting, or increased contact limits.
 
 
 
 
 
How does EngageBay compare to HubSpot?
 
 
 
EngageBay offers comparable core features to HubSpot — CRM, email automation, landing pages, live chat, and helpdesk — at a fraction of the cost. HubSpot's paid plans start at $800/month for marketing features, while EngageBay's equivalent starts at $12.74/user/month. EngageBay is specifically designed for small businesses that need an all-in-one platform without enterprise-level pricing. It has been rated as a HubSpot alternative by Zapier, Forbes, and G2.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
What features does EngageBay include?
 
 
 
EngageBay includes over 30 features across marketing, sales, and support: email marketing, marketing automation, CRM, contact management, lead scoring, sales pipelines, appointment scheduling, email templates, web forms, landing pages, live chat, helpdesk ticketing, deal management, and an AI chatbot. All features are available in one platform — no integrations required between tools.
